description: This file defines a Python class 'GenericAPILogger' for logging events to a generic API endpoint, including loading callback configurations, substituting environment variables, batching logs, and sending them asynchronously. It also includes utility functions for callback compatibility and configuration retrieval.

classes.name: GenericAPILogger
classes.description: A logger class that batches and sends log events to a specified API endpoint, supporting configuration via callback names and environment variables, with asynchronous batch processing.

methods.name: load_compatible_callbacks
methods.description: Loads the JSON configuration file for compatible callbacks.

methods.name: is_callback_compatible
methods.description: Checks if a callback name exists in the compatible callbacks list.

methods.name: get_callback_config
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration dictionary for a specific callback name.

methods.name: substitute_env_variables
methods.description: Replaces environment variable placeholders in strings with actual environment variable values.

methods.name: GenericAPILogger.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the logger, optionally loading configuration from a callback name, setting up HTTP client, headers, endpoint, and batching variables.

methods.name: _get_headers
methods.description: Constructs headers for the API request, including environment-based and default headers.

methods.name: async_log_success_event
methods.description: Asynchronously logs a success event, batching it for later transmission.

methods.name: async_log_failure_event
methods.description: Asynchronously logs a failure event, batching it for later transmission.

methods.name: async_send_batch
methods.description: Sends the current batch of logs to the API endpoint asynchronously.

methods.name: _get_v1_logging_payload
methods.description: Creates a legacy format payload for logging, maintaining backward compatibility.
